table.name: TLGNR_TRAILER_TYPE_BS
table.description: Types of Trailers. The type of a trailer characterizes special abilities/requirements. We currently distinguish 'Horizontal' (Liegend) and 'Tiltable' as the two unloading possibilities. Initially (in 1.0 pilot), 'Multi chamber Silo' and 'Container' were also listed as types of trailes. However those were identified to be conflicting or redundant with tlgnc_trailer.nr_chambers and the trailer_trsp_cat 'Container', and thus removed for 1.1

column.name: TRAILER_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=Horizontal (Liegend), 2=Tiltable (Liegend).

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
